row.team_price_text: Volume-based; Tax Calculation and Returns Compliance Package from $699
row.evidence: Avalara documents self-service SAML SSO with Okta, Entra ID and Oracle ("Avalara acts as the service provider (SP)"), but no SCIM endpoint appears in its pricing page, developer sitemap, API reference or Knowledge Center; users are added in the AvaTax UI or with the CreateUsers API.
row.notes: New row. Avalara is not seat-priced: "Many Avalara products use volume-based pricing models"; the pricing page lists bundles (Tax Calculation and Returns Compliance Package from $699, Avalara Select from $69/mo) rather than per-user tiers, so team/SSO per-user fields stay null. Self-service SAML SSO (Okta, Entra ID, Oracle IDCS/OCI IAM) covers AvaTax, Returns, ECM and other products; no plan gate is stated. No SCIM: status none by absence. Users can be created, updated and deleted through the AvaTax REST v2 Users API (no IdP connector uses it). The Okta OIN app is SWA only (read from page markup).

plans.name: Tax Calculation and Returns Compliance Package
plans.notes: Volume-based bundle, not per-user. SAML SSO is documented as self-service for AvaTax and other products with no tier named.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented. SAML SSO docs and the user-management docs mention only the AvaTax UI and the CreateUsers API.

user_api.base_url: https://sandbox-rest.avatax.com/ (sandbox base URL as shown in the reference)

auth.notes: Basic auth uses username + license key; calls need a security role such as AccountAdmin.

endpoints.purpose: Create one or more users (invite email sent)

audit_log_api.notes: ExportAuditLogs report task, then GetAuditLogReport / DownloadAuditLogReport.

okta.notes: OIN page markup shows only SWA checked (SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate unchecked); listing last updated Aug. 24 2021. Avalara's own docs describe setting up a custom SAML app in Okta.

entra.notes: No Avalara tutorial in Microsoft Learn's saas-apps table of contents; Avalara docs describe a custom SAML app in Entra ID.

jumpcloud.notes: jumpcloud.com support pages returned 403 to plain requests.
